tool.title: Complete a step
tool.description: Record an enabled step as done — or supply the facts a decision gateway is computed from — and advance the instance. Refuses a step that is not enabled.

inputs.name: outcome
inputs.description: Which branch a plain gateway takes. Refused at a gateway backed by a decision table — asserting the answer would defeat the table.

inputs.name: facts
inputs.description: Facts a DMN table is evaluated against. Structured, so it is never a command-line word.

inputs.name: actor
inputs.description: Who you say performed the step, written to the history. Authorization is decided on the principal GitHub vouches for, in strict mode (issue #1207).

inputs.name: target
inputs.description: The content the step acted on, for the access check.

inputs.name: activities
inputs.description: PROV-O activities a Tool returned while doing this step, verbatim (e.g. skill_update's `activity`). Kept on the step's history entry; each must name this step as its plan.

outputs.name: position
outputs.description: The instance's new position, and what is enabled next.

$comment.comment:
Free prose, and prose is not a command-line word — see
`tool-types` on why `Markdown` is excluded from INJECTION_SAFE.

Served since cat-harness-tools#887 (bean cat-tools-ycn6) and declared here
since bean w1gy (finding 2), owner option A of 2026-10-30. Structured,
so it has no `arg`: `ProvActivity` is not in INJECTION_SAFE, like
`DecisionFacts`. The engine also checks that each activity's
`prov:qualifiedAssociation.prov:hadPlan` ends in `#<node>`.

NOT `dmn-authoring`: EVALUATING a decision table is not AUTHORING
one, and the skill's contract says so — it requires `decisionName` and
`inputVariables`, which are what you supply to write a table, not to
answer one. `check:tools` refuses the edge.
